Meta.title: DocAgent
Meta.description: Ask questions about your own documents and get cited answers.

Landing.title: Ask your documents, get cited answers
Landing.description: DocAgent reads the PDF, Word, text and Markdown files you upload and answers your questions with quotes and page references, so you can check every claim. It can also summarise a document or compare two.
Landing.signInRequired: You need an account to use DocAgent. Create one or sign in to continue.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.draftNotice: This is a placeholder. The final privacy text is added before the public launch.
Privacy.demo: In demo mode, your questions and the matching document excerpts are sent to a free third-party model that may log them.
Privacy.byok: If you add your own provider key, your questions and excerpts go to the provider you choose.
Privacy.originals: Original files are not kept after they are processed.
Privacy.cookies: The site uses a session cookie once you sign in, short-lived cookies while you register or sign in with Google or GitHub, and a language cookie. Your theme choice is kept in your browser's local storage, and the fact that you have seen the demo privacy notice in its session storage. Neither holds personal data. There is no analytics and no tracking.
